title: NHK Special — コンビニ 社会のインフラへ (Konbini: Becoming Social Infrastructure)
description: NHK Special examining how Japan's convenience store industry transformed from a simple retail format into an essential social infrastructure. Covers the business model of 24-hour operations, franchise relationships, the fight against food waste (フードロス), the move toward unmanned stores, and konbini's role in disaster response and care for isolated elderly residents.
creator: NHK Special (NHKスペシャル)
